title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES FORMING A TASK FORCE ON THE MANILA BAY CLEANUP

text.en:
- There is hereby created a Task Force on the Manila Bay Cleanup under
the Department of Environment and Natural Resources to fast-track the bay cleanup
project, similar to the Pasig River Rehabilitation Committee, so that it could be bid
out before June 2010.

- The Philippine Gaming Corporation shall take the project on as part of
its project to build a waterfront leisure center, so that the bay cleanup project does
not have to get funding from the General Appropriations Act.

- This order shall take effect immediatel.
DONE in Manila on the 25th day of August in the Year of Our Lord, Two Thousand
flown is disage
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary'
